hardcoded_password.remediation: Remove the credential from source code, rotate the exposed secret, and retrieve it from an approved secrets-management platform.

api_key.remediation: Remove the API key from source control, rotate it, and store it in an approved secrets-management service.

api_token.description: Detects likely API or bearer-style token assignments
api_token.remediation: Revoke or rotate the token and move token retrieval to an approved secrets-management mechanism.

private_key_header.remediation: Remove the private key from source control immediately, revoke or replace the key pair, and investigate repository history for exposure.

database_connection_string.description: Detects database connection strings containing embedded credentials
database_connection_string.remediation: Remove embedded database credentials, rotate them, and use secure runtime secret injection.

debug_enabled.description: Detects debug mode enabled in configuration
debug_enabled.remediation: Disable debug mode outside approved development environments and enforce environment-specific configuration.
